title: Employ only approved teachers
what: Employ, engage or allow a person to teach in a school only if the person is an approved teacher.

sources.title: ACT Teacher Quality Institute Act 2010 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 29(1) (current republication (R28, from 6 December 2025; ACT Teacher Quality Institute Act 2010 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if–– (a) the person employs, engages or allows another person to teach in a school; and (b) the other person is not an approved teacher.
